literalGroups.primaryGround: NEI identifies the iris as the colored part of the eye (L39). It separately describes the retina, cornea, and lens by their own properties (L38, L43, L52), so only “Радужка” answers which part is colored.
literalGroups.locator: National Eye Institute: About the Eye, L38-L43, L52

literalGroups.literal: Радужка — окрашенная часть глаза. Сетчатка воспринимает свет, роговица помогает его фокусировать, а хрусталик фокусирует его на сетчатке.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The iris is the colored part (L39); the retina is light-sensitive (L52), the cornea helps focus light (L43), and the lens focuses light on the retina (L38). These distinct facts explain why the key is unique.
literalGroups.locator: National Eye Institute: About the Eye, L38-L39, L43, L52

literalGroups.literal: Сетчатка — светочувствительная ткань на задней стенке глаза; она передаёт зрительные сигналы по зрительному нерву.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page identifies the retina as light-sensitive tissue lining the back of the eyeball and says it sends electrical impulses through the optic nerve to the brain.
literalGroups.locator: National Eye Institute: About the Eye, L52

literalGroups.literal: Роговица — прозрачный купол в передней части глаза; она помогает фокусировать свет.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page describes the cornea as a clear dome covering the front of the eye and says it helps focus light.
literalGroups.locator: National Eye Institute: About the Eye, L43

literalGroups.literal: Радужка — окрашенная часть глаза; она регулирует количество света, проходящего через зрачок.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page identifies the iris as the colored part of the eye and says it regulates incoming light through the pupil by adjusting pupil size.
literalGroups.locator: National Eye Institute: About the Eye, L39-L41

literalGroups.literal: Хрусталик — прозрачная часть глаза за радужкой; он фокусирует свет на сетчатке и помогает видеть вблизи и вдали.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page describes the lens as clear, behind the iris, and helping focus light on the retina for near and far objects.
literalGroups.locator: National Eye Institute: About the Eye, L38
